grounding.observation: 343 authority and342 whole-assembly failure are reconciled. Fresh packet retains reference roles and all applicable interface lessons.
grounding.comparison: Candidate265 is structural raw material, not accepted principal or supporting art.

expert_coverage.observation: Anatomical continuity, native weighted articulation, costume support, actual shot framing and whole-person same-film read are bound to early proof.
expert_coverage.comparison: Material noise cannot resolve poor body/face/clothing form.

film_alignment.observation: Accepted Pashtun floor remains fixed; representative supporting actor must not read as a mannequin. Old265 render is explicitly unaccepted.
film_alignment.comparison: No crowd replication on a technically successful but visually weak build.

preferences.observation: Agent owns the adaptation and checks, within four remaining corrections. No routine Director handover.
preferences.comparison: Final AV and creative acceptance remain separate.

reference_roles.observation: Faithful rearing source continues governing the untouched performance owner; Pashtun sets film language, old265 supplies anatomical topology/rig only.
reference_roles.comparison: No transfer of principal identity acceptance to a rejected donor face.

method.observation: Fixed repository handler appends selected local objects only, retaining163-bone rig and shared weights.27 focused tests pass, including recipe rejection and wrist-plane control.
method.comparison: Native mask geometry, source constraints, bone lengths and clothing support remain explicit fallible assumptions checked by hard guards and actual render.

interfaces.observation: All body skin remains one weighted mesh. Garments share skeleton; eye/brow/crown ownership follows head bone. Old meshes render-hidden, not destructively removed.
interfaces.comparison: No independent neck graft. Weight transfer and coarse skirt support can still fail and must be visibly inspected in reverse/crest views.

efficient_quality.observation: One leader stance/reverse/crest before any crowd replication or long clip. Reuses local163-bone source rather than inventing another body assembly.
efficient_quality.comparison: The geometric method is a hypothesis; a new garment does not imply a production character.

authority.observation: Appearance30/max33 uses four allocated remaining shared343 corrections. Existing CC0 beard/moustache and local MPFB source only; old Harsh turban excluded.
authority.comparison: No new acquisition, model/provider call, spend, install, egress or publication.

strongest_counterexample: The donor was rejected as principal art and may still read as generic or schematic after fitting. Correct skeleton and closed skin do not prove realistic clothing or same-film quality. Reject actual whole-person failure instead of hiding it behind the new method. Retarget reach and hand silhouette are unproven until the native result.
